details:
MY PROJECT CONSISTS OF 3 COMPONENTS, A DETAILED RESEARCH REPORT, A WEBSITE (MADE IN CANVA) AND A GOOGLE EARTH SLIDESHOW.

MY RESEARCH REPORT INVOLVES ALL THE SCIENTIFIC DATA AND COMPARISONS, SUCH AS TABLES, DESCRIPTIONS, INTERACTIVE IMAGES, LINKS, AND NORMAL IMAGES. MY WEBSITE INCLUDES ALL THE EARTH ANALOGUES ARE IN THE WEBSITE AS WELL, IN AN AESTHETICALLY PLEASING AND VISUAL WAY, EQUIPPED WITH A GOOGLE EARTH SLIDE IN 3D MODE. MY INTENDED IMPACT IS FOR STUDENTS AND ENGINEERS TO ACCESS INFORMATION IN ONE PLACE, AND AQUIRE NEW LOCATIONS TO HELP TEST THEIR EQUIPMENT FOR SPACECRAFT, PARTICULARLY FOR THE MOON AND MARS, IN WHICH I TRAGETED PLACES WHICH HAS GREAT POTENTIAL FOR DISCOVRY OF LIFE.
